necessary_precision_edit.current_text: This is a concrete non-injective encoding: E(x32) = E(x64), although dtype(x32) differs from dtype(x64).
necessary_precision_edit.issue: The witnessed encodings occur in different producer processes with different runtime type allocations. Writing one unindexed deterministic E can be read as asserting a collision inside one fixed producer mapping, which the experiment did not establish.
necessary_precision_edit.suggested_replacement: Across producer processes p and q, E_p(x32) = E_q(x64), although dtype(x32) differs from dtype(x64).
necessary_precision_edit.why_it_matters: The shared-byte decoder impossibility remains valid. The edit simply exposes the runtime state already named in the experimental description instead of suppressing it in the formula.
